🏛️ Who can pass your city's budget?

A council budget needs the votes of more than half of ALL its councillors (Constitution, section 160). After the 2026 elections, only one metro has a single party with that many seats:

✅ Cape Town: DA 133 of 235 (majority 118)
Johannesburg: 136 of 270 needed. No party has it.
Tshwane: 108 of 214 needed. No party has it.
Ekurhuleni: 113 of 224 needed. No party has it.
eThekwini: 112 of 223 needed. No party has it.
Nelson Mandela Bay: 61 of 120 needed. No party has it.
Buffalo City: 51 of 100 needed. No party has it.
Mangaung: 51 of 101 needed. No party has it.

These councils will set your rates, water and electricity tariffs from 1 July 2027.

Note: seats, not mayors. Mayors are elected at each council's first sitting, within 14 days.

Source: IEC seat allocations, 8 November 2026.
